title: Connector command request
description:
POST /api/bridge/connectors/{connectorId}/request, and the params of the runtime -> plugin JSON-RPC method `connector.request`.

Authorised against the EXACT capability `connector.<connectorId>.<command>`, fail closed. Wildcards are expanded when a grant is issued, never pattern-matched at call time — matching at the boundary is how `connector.aokie.*` quietly becomes 'everything Aokie ever adds'.

idempotencyKey.description: Required for commands the plugin declares as journalled — those have side effects a retry must not repeat.
